Implement the replacement of the current daily summary system with an agentic live-update editor end to end. See the user intent and settled product decisions in this prompt.

User notes and answers:
- Settled decisions override the planner questions: daily summaries are being replaced, not updated in place. Public live updates must be posted as sequential feed items in the configured summary channel reused as the live-updates channel, without per-channel summary threads or channel-local summaries. The system is an agentic scheduled editorial loop with watchlist/editorial-memory storage, auditable run/candidate/decision state, duplicate suppression, author-context investigation, multiple update types, and ongoing top-creations behavior decoupled from the old daily flow. The plan should treat prior daily_summaries storage as legacy/migration input rather than active live-flow storage.

Implement the replacement of the current daily summary system with an agentic live-update editor end to end. See the user intent and settled product decisions in this prompt.

Public live updates must be posted as sequential feed items in the configured summary channel reused as the live-updates channel, without per-channel summary threads or channel-local summaries. The system is an agentic scheduled editorial loop with watchlist/editorial-memory storage, auditable run/candidate/decision state, duplicate suppression, author-context investigation, multiple update types, and ongoing top-creations behavior decoupled from the old daily flow. The plan should treat prior daily_summaries storage as legacy/migration input rather than active live-flow storage.

Public live updates must be posted as sequential feed items in the configured summary channel reused as the live-updates channel, without per-channel summary threads or channel-local summaries. The system is an agentic scheduled editorial loop with watchlist/editorial-memory storage, auditable run/candidate/decision state, duplicate suppression, author-context investigation, multiple update types, and ongoing top-creations behavior decoupled from the old daily flow. The plan should treat prior daily_summaries storage as legacy/migration input rather than active live-flow storage.
- Execution constraint from gate v2: if a live update exceeds Discord length limits and is split into multiple messages, the active feed-item persistence must store every posted Discord message ID in order (for example via jsonb array or ordered child rows), duplicate/admin inspection must read that ordered set, and tests must explicitly cover the >2000-character split path plus ordered persistence.
